## Context / Problem
Ten developer-tooling files contain repeated, obvious, stale, or historical prose identified by the comment audit and revalidated on `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`. Several module docstrings are user-facing argparse help and must remain complete.

## Approach
Edit only comments/docstrings and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve non-docstring AST, test assertions, shebangs, and exact tool/policy directives. Replace history and narration with current operational constraints.

## Scope
- `scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py` — Describe a bounded deterministic sequence of predetermined REST shapes, not “four calls”; preserve Q1/Q2, project-before-fields ordering, shared readiness, bounded polling/fallback, and evidence on every exit.
- `scripts/jira_dc_field_readiness.py` — Preserve the post-project precondition, measurement citation, inventory discriminator, bounded fail-closed loop, call-time defaults, and success/failure evidence.
- `scripts/main_health_report.py` — Preserve scheduled-main purpose, green/red fields, fail-soft last-green lookup, and visible fallback.
- `scripts/mutation_gate.py` — Preserve sandboxing of clean pytest, the primary mutation run, and survivor reruns; basetemp existence and writable-venv exclusion. Its module docstring is full argparse help; scoped inline comments are source-only.
- `scripts/mutation_sandbox.py` — Preserve OS isolation, functional probes, two-signal Seatbelt proof, explicit-only waiver, fail-closed policy, and external caution.
- `scripts/probe_rebar.py` — Preserve the exact bidirectional `show`/lean-list symmetric difference and conditional signature-field intersection.
- `scripts/rebar_duration_probe.py` — Preserve read-only linkage, direct versus inferred metrics, defaults, malformed-record handling, and reproducibility guidance. Its full module docstring is argparse help.
- `scripts/release_guards.py` — Describe all four guards, including `check_mcp_registry_description`; preserve their distinct return contracts, ancestry behavior, environment protection, 100-character registry-description limit, and publish ordering. Its full module docstring is argparse help.
- `scripts/retarget_jira_project.py` — Preserve stale binding/snapshot behavior, dry-run/apply, backup and tag stripping, post-preview safety, and the current report/strip help text, including the explanatory block near lines 55–60. Its full module docstring is argparse help.
- `scripts/summarize_ci_failures.py` — Preserve jobs plus annotations, timeout/cancel distinction, and comment-only/no-vote behavior.

Consumers include argparse help, CI/release workflows, manual Jira operators, mutation infrastructure, tests, and direct imports. Preserve every shebang and exact `noqa`, `type: ignore`, `pragma`, `raw-git-ok:`, and related policy directive.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The leaf commit changes only comments/docstrings or blank lines in the declared files; executable structure and exact directives remain unchanged.
- [ ] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked TSV semantic matrix authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [ ] Every edited block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row showing that redundant, obvious, duplicated, stale, or historical prose was removed while current rationale remained.
- [ ] Recorded focused checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and `make verify` pass at the leaf commit.
- [ ] Missing or FAIL semantic rows block closure.

## Verification
Run the recorded prose-only guards, focused tests, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv `make verify`. The independent matrix, not exact prose matching, judges semantic preservation.
